EXPLAIN.cell-pad: Tight cell inset — not card-padding, because this sits inside a dense table or list cell rather than a card body.
EXPLAIN.card-padding: Card body inset — not page-pad, because this is the surface padding of a card rather than the page chrome.
EXPLAIN.page-pad: Page chrome inset — not card-padding, because this pads the whole page rather than a nested card surface.
EXPLAIN.control-pad: Control hit-area inset — not row-pad, because this pads a single interactive control rather than a full content row.
EXPLAIN.row-pad: Row content inset — not cell-pad, because this pads a horizontal content row rather than a dense table cell.
EXPLAIN.pill-pad: Pill/chip inset — not control-pad, because this pads a compact badge shape rather than a form control.
EXPLAIN.sibling-stack: Same-kind peer stack — not group-boundary, because these items are repeating siblings rather than section groups.
EXPLAIN.group-boundary: Section group spacing — not sibling-stack, because these blocks are distinct groups rather than nested section groups.
EXPLAIN.block-boundary: Block-to-block spacing — not group-boundary, because this separates major blocks rather than nested section groups.
EXPLAIN.layout-split: Major layout split — not block-boundary, because this separates primary page regions rather than adjacent blocks.
EXPLAIN.marketing-beat: Marketing section beat — not layout-split, because this is a promotional rhythm rather than a structural page split.
EXPLAIN.title-subtitle: Title over supporting line — not label-field, because neither line is a form control label.
EXPLAIN.label-field: Form label above its field — not title-subtitle, because the upper line labels an input rather than a heading pair.
EXPLAIN.name-handle: Display name with handle — not title-subtitle, because the second line is an identity handle rather than a subtitle.
EXPLAIN.icon-text: Icon beside its label — not name-handle, because this pairs a glyph with text rather than a name/handle identity.
EXPLAIN.content-row: Keeps primary content and trailing meta on one baseline so the meta does not drop under the title.
EXPLAIN.flex-action: Groups action controls on one horizontal peer row so they share a single hit baseline.
EXPLAIN.flex-action-center: Centers action controls on one peer row so the CTA cluster stays visually balanced.
EXPLAIN.flex-action-end: Pins action controls to the trailing edge so primary CTAs stay at the row end.
EXPLAIN.flex-action-start: Pins action controls to the leading edge so secondary actions stay at the row start.
EXPLAIN.flex-action-between: Spreads action peers across the row so leading and trailing controls stay at opposite edges.
EXPLAIN.chip-row: Lets chips share one wrapping row so related tags stay together without stacking as a column.
EXPLAIN.card-caption: Holds caption text under card media so the caption stays attached to the image above it.
EXPLAIN.center-measure: Caps reading width so long copy does not stretch edge-to-edge across the viewport.
EXPLAIN.identity: Keeps avatar and identity text as one peer unit so the person label stays beside the face.
EXPLAIN.identity-end: Pins identity peers to the trailing edge so the person chip stays at the row end.
EXPLAIN.value-row: Holds a label and its numeric value on one baseline so the count stays readable against the label.
EXPLAIN.push-end: Pushes this peer to the trailing edge so trailing meta stays right-aligned in the row.
EXPLAIN.pin-bottom: Pins this block to the bottom of its parent so the footer action stays visible under scrolling content.
EXPLAIN.separator-dot: Places a middle-dot separator between short meta peers so the items read as one inline list.
EXPLAIN.reel: Horizontal scroll reel for overflowing peers so the row can scroll instead of wrapping the layout.
EXPLAIN.sticky-top: Keeps this bar stuck to the viewport top so navigation remains reachable while the page scrolls.
EXPLAIN.fixed-bar: Fixes this bar in the viewport so primary actions remain available over scrolling content.
EXPLAIN.stack-below: Stacks this layer below a pinned peer so the flowing content clears the sticky/fixed region.
